data.body:
RCA (PARTIAL — mechanism not experimentally proven; investigation only)

OBSERVATION
The ticket evidence shows three unrelated Gerrit changes (2648/2652/2656) taking Verified -1 in ~75s because checkout-gerrit-change-action failed before patchset code ran: `git fetch https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/rebar refs/changes/...` returned HTTP 504 after the action's ~60s fetch window. The recorded host state minutes later had `rebar-autodeploy.service` active, a freshly rebuilt `rebar-mcp-*` container, high 15-minute load, light Gerrit HTTP still healthy, and no memory exhaustion. A later natural experiment comment recorded `voter_errors` non-zero only during a four-merge window, but correctly labels that as correlation.

HYPOTHESIS
The likely mechanism is host-local CPU/IO contention, not patchset content: `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` and `_build-and-test.yml` rely on `lfreleng-actions/checkout-gerrit-change-action` against the live Gerrit refspec, while `infra/systemd/rebar-autodeploy.service` runs `/opt/rebar/infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` on the same box every timer tick. `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:deploy_review_bot` runs `docker compose build ... && docker compose up`, and the MCP path runs `docker compose build mcp` plus `docker run`/nginx cutover. Even though the service now has `Nice=10` and `IOSchedulingClass=idle`, the heavy Docker daemon/build workload is still co-resident with Gerrit and can plausibly starve large pack generation/fetches while light HTTP remains OK.

CONFIRMATION
Partial only. I confirmed the static code path and the shared-host contention shape: Gerrit Verified jobs perform live Gerrit patchset checkouts, and autodeploy performs local Docker rebuild/redeploy work on the Gerrit host. I did NOT deliberately trigger an autodeploy or run load against production Gerrit, per the safety rule. The experiment needed for complete proof is a read-only/off-box timing harness that measures `git fetch refs/changes/*` latency across an observed autodeploy start/end window versus an idle window; the hypothesis is disproven if fetch latency/error rate does not rise during autodeploy while controlling for general review/CI load.

SUGGESTED FIX DIRECTION
Treat this as a design/ops fix, not a code-only patch: add safe instrumentation first (autodeploy start/end, Docker build duration, Gerrit fetch latency, voter_errors correlation), then choose between stronger resource isolation/cgroups for Docker builds, moving builds off-host, deferring deploy during Gerrit checkout pressure, and/or a narrow CI retry on Gerrit 5xx as symptom mitigation only.
